rationale: The change alters the Evaluation Target: the original target was limited to whether braking is required to avoid collision, but it now includes either braking or an evasive lane-change maneuver. This changes the representational basis at the target level, so the existing derivation cannot be reused as-is. Per the protocol, evaluation-target changes require REDERIVE starting again at RR1. No existing ORRs are directly revalidated under this change.
